subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Which core contract should own durable subagent lifecycle receipts and audited cancel/steer/resume supervision: the existing task/audit ledgers, a new subagent lifecycle ledger, or a narrower timeline-only surface?
rationale: The remaining work crosses persistence schema, gateway protocol, audit/security policy, retention/redaction, and operator write controls, so automation cannot safely pick the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Extend shared audit/task primitives first
options.body: Use bounded redacted audit/task lifecycle primitives as the durable source, then expose subagent views on top of that contract.

options.title: Add a subagent-specific lifecycle ledger
options.body: Create a dedicated subagent event table/API with explicit lifecycle and supervision receipts, accepting a new persisted contract surface.

options.title: Keep only summaries and internal controls
options.body: Decline the broader durable receipt contract for now and leave UI timeline/safety telemetry to narrower related issues.

recommendation.title: Extend shared audit/task primitives first
recommendation.body: Use bounded redacted audit/task lifecycle primitives as the durable source, then expose subagent views on top of that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is closest to the recent task/gateway/audit-adjacent ownership trail and the protocol/security boundary that must be decided.
